description: Ohra Reservoir - 3D model setup MEWS project is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Shikhani, Muhammed (deposited on HydroShare). The project MEWS (Managing Events and Extremes in Water Supply) is a 3 year effort funded through the European Union Water4All partnership, and also with funding supplied by the funders associated with the participating countries. The project is led by Sweden with other participants from Germany, Israel, Denmark and Canada. Coverage: Germany. The resource was created 2026-07-30 and last updated 2026-07-30; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
